hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

h-JbxK-Y_i4wrt7YbHw-0Q.zh: 蘇丹南達爾富爾州(South Darfur)傑貝勒馬拉(Jebel Marra)地區爆發疑疫情。截至5/21當地通報347例病例,疫情於一週內急速攀升,目前尚未有死亡病例報告,且病毒分支(clade)與實驗室檢驗結果仍待確認。該區收容約70萬名流離失所者,極度擁擠的難民營、缺乏衛生設施與疫苗,加上醫療監測系統崩潰,致傳播風險極高。 中國近期通報2例具香港旅遊史的確診病例。2名男性(28及30歲)潛伏期內均曾造訪香港旺角同一場所,並有高風險行為,其後陸續出現發燒、腹股溝腫痛及下肢紅疹等症狀後確診。2022年迄今,香港累計86例確診病例(含69例本土與17例境外移入個案),且個案皆為男性。
h-JbxK-Y_i4wrt7YbHw-0Q.en: A suspected outbreak has occurred in the Jebel Marra area of South Darfur State, Sudan. As of 21 May, 347 cases had been reported locally. Cases rose sharply within one week. No deaths have been reported so far, and the clade and laboratory results remain pending. The area hosts about 700,000 displaced people; extremely crowded refugee camps, lack of sanitation and vaccines, and the collapse of the health monitoring system make the transmission risk extremely high. China recently reported two confirmed cases with a history of travel to Hong Kong. The two men, aged 28 and 30, both visited the same venue in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, during their incubation period and engaged in high-risk behaviour. They subsequently developed fever, groin swelling and pain, and lower-limb rashes, and were then confirmed. Since 2022, Hong Kong has reported 86 cumulative confirmed cases (69 local and 17 imported), all in men.

jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/7-13期間,cVDPV1新增衣索比亞4例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞6例、剛果民主共和國3例及蘇丹1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件。
jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 May, cVDPV1 added four cases in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: six in Nigeria, three in the DRC and one in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added nine specimens in Pakistan.

FJa5czBJEyvMqzC3HDp-Cw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/16-22期間,cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為蘇丹2例、剛果民主共和國1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2 新增4國共4件,分別為馬拉威/納米比亞/索馬利亞/蘇丹各1件。
FJa5czBJEyvMqzC3HDp-Cw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 16 and 22 April, cVDPV2 added three cases across two countries: two in Sudan and one in the DRC. For environmental samples, WPV1 added two specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added four specimens across four countries, one each in Malawi, Namibia, Somalia and Sudan.

Jn0sgwhXOawvxnGBHLv0KA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 4/9-15 期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗 2 例;cVDPV1 新增南蘇丹 2 例;cVDPV2 新增蘇丹 4 例;環境樣本部分,WPV1 新增巴基斯坦 1 件,cVDPV2 新增 2 國共 3 件,分別為蘇丹 2 件、納米比亞 1 件。
Jn0sgwhXOawvxnGBHLv0KA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 9 and 15 April, WPV1 added two cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 added two cases in South Sudan; and cVDPV2 added four cases in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added one specimen in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added three specimens across two countries: two in Sudan and one in Namibia.

1NkiVb5Rg-xHOuPQLbE9kQ.zh: 智利復活節島報告2024年以來首例本土病例,截至3/8累計14例確診病例,有2例住院治療。當地於2002年爆發由DENV-1引發之疫情,其後經歷多次不同流行型別疫情,為該國登革熱主要傳播地區。 蘇丹北方州病例數快速上升,截至3/7累計報告逾600例病例及4例死亡,該國自去年迄今年2月報告逾63,000例疑病例,分布於數州。疫情通常在6月雨季開始後上升,並持續至10月。
1NkiVb5Rg-xHOuPQLbE9kQ.en: Easter Island in Chile reported its first local case since 2024; 14 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively as of 8 March, and 2 are hospitalized. The island had an outbreak caused by DENV-1 in 2002, followed by several outbreaks of different serotypes, and it is the main dengue transmission area in the country. In Northern State, Sudan, case numbers have risen rapidly: as of 7 March, more than 600 cases and 4 deaths have been reported cumulatively. The country reported more than 63,000 suspected cases from last year through February this year, distributed across several states. Outbreaks usually rise after the rainy season begins in June and continue until October.

GAO0pzY4j8kI5lNH1iLkpQ.zh: 蘇丹自2024年7月迄今累計報告逾12萬例病例,其中,3,573例死亡,當局已持續加強防治措施,包含推動2,300萬人接種疫苗、提升飲水衛生措施等,截至3/3已連續48天監測無通報病例,當局宣布成功終止疫情。
GAO0pzY4j8kI5lNH1iLkpQ.en: Since July 2024, Sudan has reported more than 120,000 cumulative cases, including 3,573 deaths. Authorities have continued to strengthen control measures, including vaccinating 23 million people and improving drinking water hygiene. As of 3 March, the country had recorded 48 consecutive days with no reported cases, and authorities declared that the outbreak had been successfully ended.

WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.zh: 非洲2025年截至12/21累計報告逾31萬例病例,其中約3,000例死亡,有88%的病患居住在南蘇丹、蘇丹、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉及奈及利亞,非洲CDC提出整合性策略以對抗疫情;另全球每年約有130-400萬人感染,造成2-14萬人死亡。
WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.en: In Africa, cumulative cases in 2025 up to 21 December exceeded 310,000, of which about 3,000 died. 88% of patients lived in South Sudan, Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Nigeria. The Africa CDC has proposed an integrated strategy to combat the outbreak. Globally, an estimated 1.3–4 million people are infected each year, causing 20,000–140,000 deaths.

uXqElHLjA0gYuArFop8WJw.zh: 越南疫情更新,近1週(11/14-20)新增6,472例病例及1例死亡,較前1週病例數減少7.3%,今年迄今累計156,828例病例及32例死亡,高於去年同期病例數及死亡數,該國於2022年疫情較為嚴峻,累計逾370,000例病例。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日新增705例病例,今年迄今累計90,969例病例及366例死亡,病例數以該國南部巴里薩爾專區20,224例為多。 茅利塔亞自今年5月疫情爆發迄今累計7,179例病例(4,029例確診)及1例死亡(致死率為0.01%),主要檢出型別為DENV-1及DENV-2。今年非洲共11國累計報告逾56,000例病例及125例死亡,其中,病例數以蘇丹共和國約42,000例為多,其次為茅利塔亞。
uXqElHLjA0gYuArFop8WJw.en: Viet Nam update: In the past week (14–20 November), 6,472 new cases and 1 death were reported, a 7.3% decrease in cases from the previous week. Year to date, 156,828 cases and 32 deaths have been reported cumulatively, higher than the same period last year in both cases and deaths. The country had a severe outbreak in 2022, with a cumulative total of more than 370,000 cases. Bangladesh update: 705 new cases were reported in the past day. Year to date, 90,969 cases and 366 deaths have been reported, with the most cases, 20,224, in the Barisal division of southern Bangladesh. Mauritania: Since its outbreak began in May this year, a cumulative 7,179 cases (4,029 confirmed) and 1 death (case fatality rate 0.01%) have been reported, mainly serotypes DENV-1 and DENV-2. In Africa this year, 11 countries have cumulatively reported more than 56,000 cases and 125 deaths. Sudan has the most cases, about 42,000, followed by Mauritania.

SmQNnsjwwRSYaK6TShBeng.zh: 非洲多國爆發疫情,  蘇丹首都喀土穆報告15例,且3例病例於3日內死亡,當地公衛狀況及防疫體系急遽惡化,專家示警當地將發生疫情,需相關部門立即介入。 阿爾及利亞東北部斯基克達省爆發群聚疫情,10/17-19間報告5例,其中2例死亡,包括1名25歲外國人及1名未接種疫苗之12歲當地女孩。病患皆於住院後因呼吸道併發症死亡,其餘3例仍在治療,當局已進行接觸者追蹤及暴露後預防工作,鄰近地區亦加強監測措施。 馬利報告343例疑病例,其中7例確診及25例死亡(CFR : 7.3%),病例多集中於該國中部莫普提(Mopti)地區,當局現進行疫苗接種活動,目前疫情已獲控制。
SmQNnsjwwRSYaK6TShBeng.en: Outbreaks have occurred in several African countries. Khartoum, the capital of Sudan, reported 15 cases, and three of the cases died within three days. Local public health conditions and the disease control system have deteriorated sharply, and experts warn that an outbreak will occur locally, calling for immediate intervention by the relevant authorities. In Skikda province in north-eastern Algeria, a cluster outbreak was reported: five cases were reported between 17 and 19 October, of which two died, including a 25-year-old foreigner and an unvaccinated 12-year-old local girl. The two deceased patients died of respiratory complications after hospitalization, and the other three cases are still under treatment. Authorities have carried out contact tracing and post-exposure prevention, and surveillance has been strengthened in neighbouring areas. Mali reported 343 suspected cases, of which 7 were confirmed and 25 died (CFR 7.3%). Cases are concentrated in the Mopti region of central Mali. Authorities are carrying out vaccination activities, and the outbreak is now reported to be under control.

SMVaJAkJZhSVXVy2Aw1hkA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/15-21期間,cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為蘇丹及奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為德國/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞各1件。
SMVaJAkJZhSVXVy2Aw1hkA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 15 and 21 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 2 in 2 countries, one each in Sudan and Nigeria. For environmental samples, cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries, one each in Germany, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea.

2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/8-14期間,cVDPV2型新增4國共9例,分別為衣索比亞5例、蘇丹2例、布吉納法索/象牙海岸各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦11件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加3國共5件,分別為阿爾及利亞3件、查德/索馬利亞各1件。
2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 8 and 14 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 in 4 countries: 5 in Ethiopia, 2 in Sudan, and 1 each in Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 11 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 3 countries: 3 in Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Somalia.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.zh: 東非蘇丹疫情嚴峻,去年12/3已知感染病例達48,000例,其中18%正在接受治療,另12/23報載南蘇丹瓊萊州產前檢查陽性孕婦人數亦明顯上升,推測社會動盪及缺乏醫療資源應為當地疫情上升主因;烏干達去年全國盛行率約5.1%,其中,卡蘭加拉區較為嚴峻,盛行率約12.8%,惟近年已有明顯下降。
ALtO__tag2swj8Yyk1f-TQ.en: The HIV situation in Sudan in East Africa is severe: as of 3 December 2024, 48,000 known infections had been recorded, and 18% of them were receiving treatment. Media reported on 23 December that the number of pregnant women testing positive at antenatal screening in Jonglei State, South Sudan, had also risen markedly. The rise is presumed to be mainly due to social unrest and a lack of medical resources. Uganda's national prevalence in 2024 was about 5.1%; Kalangala District is more severe, with a prevalence of about 12.8%, although it has declined markedly in recent years.

GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至11/24累計33國報告733,000餘例病例及逾5,000例死亡;分別較去年同期增加37%及27%,病例數以東地中海區、非洲區及東南亞區為多,地區性戰爭衝突、自然災害等因素降低醫療服務資源可近性並加劇爆發疫情,WHO於11月通過審查新疫苗配方及生產流程,疫苗產量達2013年以來新高,以應付目前疫苗短缺之情況,評估全球疫情風險仍為非常高。 非洲地區今年截至12/21累計報告逾219,000例及3,500餘例死亡(CFR: 1.6%),南蘇丹於10月下旬宣布爆發疫情,迄今累計4,700餘例及47例死亡(CFR: 0.9%);蘇丹今年迄今累計49,000餘例及892例死亡(CFR: 1.8%),兩國近期受人道危機及天災影響,疫情持續擴大;迦納、莫三比克、坦尚亞及辛巴威持續報告病例。
GpgpR5XCis2pppE1wg2n8Q.en: WHO reported that globally as of 24 November this year, 33 countries had reported over 733,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths, increases of 37% and 27% respectively over the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in the Eastern Mediterranean, African and South-East Asian regions. Regional wars and conflicts, and natural disasters, have reduced access to health services and aggravated outbreaks. WHO approved a review of a new vaccine formulation and production process in November, and vaccine output reached its highest level since 2013 to address the current vaccine shortage. The global outbreak risk is still assessed as very high. In Africa, as of 21 December this year, over 219,000 cases and over 3,500 deaths (CFR 1.6%) had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan declared an outbreak in late October; to date, over 4,700 cases and 47 deaths (CFR 0.9%) have been recorded. Sudan has recorded over 49,000 cases and 892 deaths (CFR 1.8%) this year. Both countries are affected by humanitarian crises and natural disasters, and their outbreaks continue to expand. Ghana, Mozambique, Tanzania and Zimbabwe continue to report cases.

PmqE2M-4LiG3QCjDMJ6foA.zh: 蘇丹東部傑濟拉州阿爾希拉利亞市(al-Hilaliya)11/7爆發不明原因腹瀉群聚事件,累計至少73例死亡;當地近期受軍事襲擊,無法確認爆發疫情原因。
PmqE2M-4LiG3QCjDMJ6foA.en: In al-Hilaliya city in Gezira State, eastern Sudan, an unexplained diarrhoeal cluster broke out on 7 November, with at least 73 deaths cumulatively reported. Due to recent military attacks in the area, the cause of the outbreak cannot be confirmed.
